reviews.comment: Amazing quality, and you cant beat the price. Looks great and performs well. Low noise. No vibration. Plenty fast and moves a lot of air. I would recommend for anyone.

reviews.author: gary

reviews.title: Always Arctic for the Win!
reviews.comment: Fantastic Fans - These are 3k RPM fans designed to move large volumes of air. Undoubtedly, Arctic makes top-tier fans. They are easy to install, and the ARGB is fantastic. Like others have stated, run each fan to a controller; in my case, an Airgoo controller. The colors are vibrant, and the cooling is off the charts. The static pressure these create is outstanding. I've tuned my fan curves so there really is no noise issue.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Look good, feel good, work good.
reviews.comment:
These are great. I replaced my Corsair 4000D's intakes and bought another for the exhaust. It started with how satisfied I was with the Arctic Freezer Pro III. These fans ramp up to 3000 easily. You'll most likely not need those RPMs, and you'll start to hear the fans spinning at those rates. Once I tuned them down, they are very quiet. I can receive positive air pressure in my rig, and I'm running my 9 9950x under 60C playing BG3 in 4k Ultra.
I'd give them 5 stars if they had a little less profile depth and were a little quieter at 3k RPM, if possible.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.comment:
Excellent reverse fan, put at the bottom of the case and tuned with pwm  bios profile at slight lower speed than the forward fans (they naturally make a bit more noise but it is typical of reverse fan). Since they here to ease fresh air into the case, I have no pb with lower speed to keep the overall system very silent.
I own noctua fans, and they are a premium alternative when price comes into play
